decisions.summary: A module-level @cache _loaded(research_dir) returning store.load, called by _record_text's question branch in place of store.load, keyed by the normpath'd directory record_text already passes.
decisions.why: Implements FR-001 (one load per directory per process between clear_caches) and FR-002 (keyed as the page cache keys it) literally; only the question branch calls it, so the spec's never-reads-a-question-page edge case holds. Note, not a narrowing: os.path.normpath unifies a trailing slash but not a relative and an absolute name, so D1's 'a directory named two ways is one record' is true for the first and not the second - the cost is a second load of the same directory, never a page from the wrong record, and FR-002 asks for the page cache's keying, which this is.

decisions.summary: _loaded joins the tuple clear_caches() clears; an unread page is rendered from the record as loaded since the last clear_caches.
decisions.why: FR-003 verbatim; the staleness change is the one the accepted spec's Assumptions name. The only clear_caches caller is record/site.py (the build), and a grep of the fixture-record tests that call record_text found none that edits a fragment after a read in the same directory; FR-006 and make done hold the rest.

decisions.summary: The question branch still calls store.page_html(record, record.by_file[name], research_dir) with the same arguments; SC-004 compared against a fresh store.load per page.
decisions.why: FR-004 / SC-004. A per-page fresh load is the right oracle (it is what the old code did, and it would catch a page_html that mutates the shared record). Aside on cost, not a fidelity ruling: as a permanent test it is ~475 loads, the very pattern R1 measured at ~42 s; the spec's SC-004 asks for a comparison before and after, which a one-shot run or the full tier satisfies equally.

decisions.summary: text_of becomes record_text(rel); _real_record is removed; callers keep the name.
decisions.why: FR-005 and User Story 3 verbatim: the helper's body is a call to record_text, no restated engine calls.

decisions.summary: _loaded carries a 'Research: record load cache - NONE: process plumbing' claim; _record_text and clear_caches keep theirs, re-checked only if make claims-owed owes it.
decisions.why: Compliance with the repository's standing feature-316 claim rule for a new unit; changes no behavior and narrows nothing asked.

decisions.summary: make perf LABEL=322-start on unmodified code and 322-end at the last commit, with perf-report against the start.
decisions.why: Constitution VI procedure for an engine change; the start bookend is taken on d8851588e-era unmodified code as the plan says.

decisions.summary: Load-count, two-directory, and edit-after-clear_caches tests on fixture records in test_sources.py; SC-004 over the real record; the four record tests timed and recorded in research.md.
decisions.why: Each test enforces an FR/SC the accepted spec carries (SC-001 to SC-005); enforcement of what was asked, no new behavior.
